name: The Scindia School
description: About Us The history of The Scindia School provides a fascinating insight into the changes happening in India from feudal times to the modern day. The Scindia School was founded as The Sardar School in 1897 by the visionary HH Maharaja Madhavrao Scindia I . The turn of the nineteenth century was a period of turmoil and disorientation, as the colonial system of education with English as the medium of instruction, was displacing the traditional pathshalas, madarsas and gurukuls . However, even then, the school captured the best of the learning of the new world and combined it with the finest of timeless India. In this respect, The Scindia School has been the torchbearer of modern education systems, combining it with a unique Indian ethos. It has been, in every way, always one step ahead of the times. The School with its unique location, atop the historic Gwalior Fort, is a residential school with a difference. The ramparts of the Fort have witnessed history unfold : Tatya Tope’s troops battling the British, and the Rani of Jhansi breathing her last in her final assault. A casual glance out of a classroom window may well find eyes resting on an exquisite sixth century temple, adorned with bas-reliefs. Amidst such surroundings, tranquil, yet with so much to tell, academics take on added dimensions. Here academic striving encompasses a life-long thirst for scholarship and curiosity. The Scindia School aims to instill a progressive mind-set and nurture leaders of tomorrow, who will succeed in any endeavour that they turn their hand to, anywhere in the world, and yet retain an unmistakable Indian ethos and Sanskar.

description: About Us EndFragment Scindia Kanya Vidyalaya (SKV) is Known to be one of the best Girls' boarding schools in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh known for its quality education and holistic programs. The school was inaugurated by President Dr. Rajendra Prasad, who emerged from the vision of the Late Rajmata Vijaya Raje Scindia to educate girls in newly independent India. For over six decades, Scindia Kanya Vidyalaya School Gwalior has maintained its commitment to blending traditional values with progressive education. The Scindia Kanya school offers a CBSE-affiliated curriculum from classes VI-XII, with streams in Science, Humanities, and Commerce. Our experiential learning approach, powered by partnerships with XSeed Education, digital classrooms, and a 10:1 student-teacher ratio, ensures personalized attention and academic excellence. SKV's Gwalior has unique initiatives including the Dharohar Festival, celebrating Indian heritage, and SANKALP, fostering entrepreneurship and community service. Our comprehensive sports program, cultural activities, and various clubs provide students with diverse opportunities for personal growth. The school follows a system of CCE - Continuous Comprehensive Evaluation for classes VI - X where a student's performance is assessed throughout the academic session based on Formative and Summative assessments. The Scindia Kanya Vidyalaya residential system, comprising five boarding houses, creates a nurturing environment where students develop independence, leadership, and strong values. Our alumni have emerged as leaders across various fields, a testament to SKV's success in shaping confident, cultured, and compassionate young women.

name: Shrewsbury International School India
description: About Us Shrewsbury International School stands out as a well-known boarding school in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh. Spread over a 150-acre campus in Bhopal, recognized as one of India’s cleanest and most environmentally friendly capitals. Designed to serve students aged 11 to 18 years, the school will have a planned capacity of 800 pupils, ensuring a supportive and personalized educational environment. Shrewsbury International School in India extends the 472-year legacy of academic excellence from the historic Shrewsbury School in the UK. The School curriculum will be aligned with the English National Curriculum, equipping students to undertake the Cambridge International IGCSE Examinations during their Years 10 and 11. Successfully passing these examinations will enable pupils to progress to A Level courses in Years 12 and 13, facilitating their further academic pursuits and preparing them for higher education. The school maintains small class sizes of 20 students at the IGCSE level and 12 at A Levels, ensuring personalised attention and optimal learning outcomes. To enrich the educational experience, the Shrewsbury School a well-known school in Bhopal, India campus seeks to integrate the spiritual values deeply rooted in Indian society with the best practices and traditions of British independent schools. This fusion aims to create a distinctive learning environment that draws upon the strengths and cultural richness of both backgrounds, benefitting the educational journey of every pupil. Shrewsbury Boarding School has a 160,000 sq. ft air-conditioned academic block that houses modern classrooms, specialized laboratories, and collaborative learning spaces. Notable facilities include a 5,000 sq. ft Design & Technology lab equipped with CNC machines and 3D printers, and a 10,000 sq. ft library offering extensive academic resources. StartFragment EndFragment The school's commitment to excellence extends beyond academics through comprehensive co-curricular programs in sports, music, drama, and various activities. It offers multiple scholarship opportunities and founding pupil bursaries. Shrewsbury boarding school admission process is discussed above.

name: Bhartiyam Vidya Niketan
description: About Us Welcome to the website of Bhartiyam! As you navigate the website exploring what we offer, you will find answers to many queries that you may have about our school. The site showcases the wealth of experiences we offer our students. The sketch drawn a few years back for Bharatiyam Vidya Niketan (BVN) has changed into something more concrete – the lines are more defined and the colours have begun to fill in! It is said that school days are the best days of life. The first step of the epic journey of life begins here, where the entire learning process takes place. Academic excellence along with co-curricular, extra-curricular and sports activities completes the process of education. It gives me great satisfaction that the school is performing extremely well and progressing in all its endeavours to ensure academics as well as human excellence. Our Board results too,have shown an upward swing and this gives me confidence that our students will make a difference to the lives they touch. In its vast and beautiful environs, the school nurtures education as an intricately planned endeavour. The school imbibes updates and upgrades itself consistently regarding the latest innovations in pedagogy. All CBSE directives are implemented with immediate effect. An array of events and activities are incorporated in the school calendar. BVN is a place where our students are encouraged to say - “I see it, I get it and I can do it!” We work together to help our students fill their life with the light of positivity. Here students are encouraged to investigate, analyse and evaluate their experiences, to be inquisitive and to think independently. In times to come we will continue this mission with increased enthusiasm and persistently provide a platform for holistic learning. Dear Students – the desire to excel, your success and your future, all lie squarely in your hands - gain as much as you can from your school life! VISION BHARTIYAM VIDYA NIKETAN is widely recognised as a leading educational institution in India, influencing the world. The inspirational staff creates an exceptional learning environment that motivates all the students to be global minded, academically successful, well balanced and prepare for future challenges and responsibilities. MISSION Bhartiyam aims to foster responsible global citizens and leaders by providing a world-class international education and training that empowers students to be inspired learners through the collaboration of a dedicated faculty and a supportive parents fraternity.

description: About Us Gyan Ganga Orchids – The International School, Jabalpur, is among the top residential schools in India. It is a project of Shri Wardhman Vidya Vihar Educational Academy, a chain of schools and professional colleges in Central India. Founded in 2000 as Gyan Ganga International School, the institution has grown into a trusted name in education, setting benchmarks in quality and innovation. It has introduced advanced teaching techniques within the conventional education system and grown into a school with a global presence. The institution stands as one of the best residential schools in India, achieving self-sustained, donation-free growth and earning recognition as a Senior Secondary, Co-educational, Residential, and Day School. In 2003, the group expanded into professional education with the Gyan Ganga Institute of Technology and Sciences. Responding to increasing demand, another engineering college was established in 2006, along with professional programs in MBA and MCA. The professional colleges are approved by AICTE, New Delhi. Today this college has B.Tech, M.Tech, MBA, B.Pharma, D.Pharma, Hotel Management, Integrated 5 yrs BA.LLB. , B.Com. and BBA Courses in this campus. In all, Gyan Ganga Group has over 12000 students in its different campuses.
